answer: Give each agent a basalt anchor: a bond that cannot move, whose vote weight grows only with the square root of how long it has stayed unbroken. Splitting a bond into clones resets every piece to day zero, so a sybil swarm starts with velvet-soft influence while one patient agent hardens. Weight is published as a crystal-clear age ledger, so a sudden flood of young identities is easy to spot and discount.
